name: Founders Pledge
summary: A community of entrepreneurs who pledge part of their exit proceeds to charity, with research on where to give, advice for members and ultra-wealthy Philanthropy Partners, donor-advised funds and public funds (Climate Fund, Catalytic Impact Fund, Global Catastrophic Risks Fund). In 2025 its community gave $359 million, $196 million of it to the charities it recommends, mostly in climate, education and global health. Founders Pledge Ltd (UK charity 1162201) with Founders Pledge Inc (US 501(c)(3)) and Founders Pledge gGmbH (Germany).

spending.source: https://register-of-charities.charitycommission.gov.uk/en/charity-search/-/charity-details/5061733/accounts-and-annual-returns (Founders Pledge Ltd, consolidated group accounts for the year ended 31 December 2025, audited by Crowe U.K. LLP: charitable activities £249,984,351 less grants £240,837,201, at the IRS's 2025 average of $1.3175 per pound. The grants from members' donor-advised funds and its pooled funds are donors' money, the recipients' cost.)
